subject: Converting subscription to AWS Marketplace billing for renewal
messages:
From: James Park <james.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Moving our Redwood subscription to AWS Marketplace before renewal

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from procurement — our renewal for Redwood is coming up on 2026-03-31 and finance has asked whether we can convert our existing direct contract to AWS Marketplace billing so charges come through our AWS account. They prefer marketplace billing for consolidated invoicing and to use our negotiated enterprise terms.

Questions from procurement:
- Will this require a new order/DocuSign or can you map our existing subscription (same seats) to a marketplace SKU?
- Any change in pricing or effective renewal date we should expect?
- Who at Redwood we should coordinate with to ensure no service interruption?

Can you loop in the right folks and confirm steps/timeline? We need to know if this can be completed before our renewal date.

Thanks,
James Park
Head of Procurement
Acme Corporation

Attachment: initial_procurement_questionnaire.docx (docx, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <james.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Moving our Redwood subscription to AWS Marketplace before renewal

Hi James — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire. Short answer: yes, we can move Acme to AWS Marketplace billing ahead of the renewal, but there are a few operational steps so I want to make sure we coordinate runbook and timelines. Looping in Rishi (sales engineering) and Connor (partner ops) to own the technical/ops side.

Proposed high-level steps:
1) Confirm the SKU & subscription mapping (Rishi will propose the SKU + MPN mapping).
2) Create an AWS Marketplace private offer / SaaS contract and get DocuSign execution.
3) Update entitlement mapping so Acme's existing seats carry over to the new marketplace subscription (no downtime).
4) Finance: generate a marketplace invoice schedule and confirm renewal cutoff date.

Rishi / Connor — can you pick this up and capture any constraints (e.g., any extra lead time for entitlement publishing, marketplace approval windows, or pricing deltas)? James, if you can share the procurement contact and any internal PO/contract IDs in the questionnaire we can accelerate.

I can also coordinate a short 30-min call with AWS marketplace co-sell ops if needed — they sometimes expect a 7–10 business day lead time for private offers to be fully provisioned.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, James Park <james.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Moving our Redwood subscription to AWS Marketplace before renewal

Hi all — note on the SKU/pricing side and operational constraints.

SKU & pricing: We will publish a Marketplace SKU that mirrors the current seat-based tier Acme is on. There is a small marketplace transaction fee (passed through by AWS) but Redwood will absorb a portion as part of the renewal offer to keep net customer cost neutral for this renewal period. I attached the proposed pricing sheet and the marketplace order template for procurement.

Entitlements & timeline:
- Publishing a private offer and getting AWS to approve the entitlement mapping typically takes 5–8 business days once we submit the private offer.
- After DocuSign/order execution, AWS propagates the subscription across buyer accounts within 24–48 hours in most cases.
- If you need marketplace billing to backdate to the current contract anniversary we can discuss proration, but typical approach is set the effective start date on the marketplace order to the renewal date so billing continuity is preserved.

Action items:
- James: confirm procurement contact + PO ID (from questionnaire) and sign the marketplace order template.
- Marissa: please kick off DocuSign with the attached aws_marketplace_order_template.pdf (I filled in most fields).
- Connor: ping Partner Ops to prime AWS co-sell and request expedited review (Connor, can you pull the AWS TAM into the thread?).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_aws_mp_pricing_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 62KB); aws_marketplace_order_template.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: James Park <james.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Moving our Redwood subscription to AWS Marketplace before renewal

Marissa / Rishi — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from procurement after reviewing the template: 

- Procurement asks for a Marketplace SKU line item and the exact product code to put on our internal PO. Can you add the SKU code in the order template (field: Marketplace Product Code)?
- We need the DocuSign envelope to list Acme's billing address and reference our PO# ACME-2026-045.
- Is Redwood able to accept marketplace billing starting on 2026-03-31 (renewal date)? If there's any gap in subscription mapping we will ask for a short-term overlap credit.

I'll attach the PO info in a sec — attaching the questionnaire filled and PO reference. If you can produce the finalized order template with SKU and the DocuSign link, Procurement can sign within 24–48 hours. We would like to avoid any manual invoice reconciliations during the first billing cycle.

Thanks,
James

To: James Park <james.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Moving our Redwood subscription to AWS Marketplace before renewal

Thanks James — all good. Summary & next steps to make sure we hit 2026-03-31: 

1) Rishi will add the Marketplace Product Code (MPN/SKU) to the order template and return a finalized PDF by EOD 2026-02-25.
2) I will start the DocuSign envelope once Rishi updates the template; DocuSign link will be shared with Procurement and copied to this thread (expect the envelope within 24 hours of template finalization).
3) Connor — please escalate to Partner Ops and request the AWS TAM for expedited private-offer approval. We want the private offer published the same day the DocuSign is completed.
4) James/Acme — please sign the DocuSign and confirm PO# ACME-2026-045. We'll set the marketplace effective start date to 2026-03-31 and handle any prorations on Redwood's side if there is propagation delay.

I'll also open a HubSpot task (linked) and a finance ticket to track invoicing timeline. If AWS needs to be looped into a short call, I'm available Wed 2026-02-25 10–11am PT.

Thanks everyone — I'll update this thread as items complete.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
